_comment: Per-chain row label -> physical position rules. Hand-edit as you verify chains against real seat maps. 'strategy' controls how a raw row label/order maps to a physical row number (1 = closest to screen). 'overrides' lets you pin specific (theater_id, label) -> physical_row pairs when a chain has removed rows for recliner/ADA conversions.

amc.note: AMC labels rows A,B,C... skipping I and O. Many auditoriums are now recliner seating with renumbered rows, so DOM/API order is more reliable than the label. We use DOM order when available and fall back to letter parsing.

regal.note: Mixed labeling that varies by theater. Trust DOM/API order over label.

cinemark.note: Cinemark (incl. Century, CineArts, Tinseltown) is typically numeric, but some auditoriums use letters. Confirm per response; falls back to DOM order.

marcus.note: Generic fallback: DOM/API order = physical position. Raw label logged for later refinement.

cineplex.note: Generic fallback: DOM/API order = physical position. Raw label logged for later refinement.
